Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
xi...@waste.org (Xian) wrote:
> This is something Justin Fang posted a while ago, and I couldn't find an
> answer on Deja News...so if you would be so kind, LSJ
>

> Justin Fang wrote: Since neither the Ghouled Street Thug nor the Blood
> Brother Ambush has a listed hand damamge, neither can make hand strikes. But
> what if one of them uses Torn Signpost? Would that give them a base hand
> damage of 2, allowing them to make hand strikes, use Undead Strength, etc?

Allies in general now have a default strength of zero, so they
can strike with their hands for zero damage. [6.4.5]

They can use Lucky Blow as normal, or get their strength reset by Torn
Signpost if they can play potence cards, etc.
